sections.title: Plant and reporting period
sections.description: Use the proprietor name and bonded-premises address shown on the permit. Quantities belong to the selected reporting month.

sections.title: Transaction descriptions
sections.description: Identify the Other spirits column when used. The official instructions direct you to consult TTB before using blank transaction lines 13 or 16.

sections.title: Part I — Transactions
sections.description: All quantities are proof gallons. Row totals and Produced totals calculate after every component is entered; blanks are not treated as zero. Line 17 is quarter-end physical inventory.

sections.description: Identify each kind of spirit. For alcohol or spirits, indicate 190° or over or under 190°. Report imported spirits separately.

sections.title: Part VI — Materials used
sections.description: Enter each quantity in its specified unit. Pounds and gallons are separate measurements and are never added together.
